game_concept: A card battler set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the vowels value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about vowels to power up the sherpa guide and open the rescue sled.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks

code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
